name: heading
description: Semantic heading (h1-h6) with a safe default scale and an optional visual-size override.
designIntent: Document structure and visual size are different axes: screen readers and SEO need the correct h-level, while design sometimes needs a smaller visual size. Heading takes level (semantic) and size (visual) separately so outline integrity never gets sacrificed for typography.

props.name: level
props.description: Semantic level — renders the matching h1..h6 element.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size override, independent of the semantic level.

props.name: muted
props.description: Use the muted-foreground token instead of the primary text color.

examples.title: Structural heading with visual override
examples.code:
<Heading level={2}>Section title</Heading>

{/* h4 semantics (correct outline position) but large visual size) */}
<Heading level={4} size="2xl">Card headline</Heading>

antiPatterns.title: Never skip levels for styling
antiPatterns.explanation: Jumping h1 -> h3 breaks the outline assistive tech announces. Use size for visual weight; level stays sequential.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Text as a heading
antiPatterns.explanation: A bolded paragraph is not a heading: navigation panes and find-in-page won't index it.

accessibility.implementation: Renders h1..h6 from the level prop; default scale keeps visual hierarchy aligned with structure
accessibility.userRequirements: One h1 per page; no skipped levels between headings
Avoid custom color classes on headings

compositionRules.relationship: Headings introduce sections; Text carries the prose
